mentions.name: Working Balm
mentions.description: An all-purpose balm for lips, hands and skin, developed through over 130 test batches. It is formulated as a more useful, less gooey alternative to typical petroleum- and silicone-based lip balms.
mentions.problem: Typical gooey lip balms are full of petroleum and silicone and are not useful to carry.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been experimenting (over 130 test batches so far) with creating an all-purpose balm (lip, hands... stuff).

https://workingbalm.com

I wanted something more useful to carry than typical gooey lips balm full of petroleum and silicone.
